ssl-https-http.title: Kopo e e sa siamang
ssl-https-http.description: Webosaete eno e ka fitlhelelwa ka HTTPS. O lekile go golagana ka HTTP; jaanong re tla leka go go isa kwa go sele. Fa o sa isiwe teng, tsweetswee tsenya https:// kwa tshimologong ya URL ya gago mme o leke gape.
